criteria.criterion: The rehearsal provisions its throwaway scratch projects with the hardened pinned template and verifies their capabilities before any scenario runs; checked by asserting each created project reports the required issue types/fields (a degrade fails provisioning, not a later scenario).
Issues created in two scratch projects are both ingested in one pass with the correct source project and repos recorded; checked by querying both projects and asserting both tickets' fields.
Rebar-created tickets targeting each project land in that project only; checked by querying the projects and asserting each issue exists in exactly one.
A ticket with an explicit empty project creates no issue in any project; checked by a post-run query of every scratch project finding no issue for it.
All three repo configurations (one/two/zero repos) produce the expected repos on inbound tickets and correct routing on outbound ones; checked per configuration.

An outbound update targeting a project outside the configured scope is surfaced in `bridge preview`'s planned mutation set and, on `bridge sync`, raises `CrossProjectTargetError` from the write-path guard and changes nothing; checked by comparing the projects' issue state before and after the refused sync.

A project key never created in the DC instance, when configured in the mapping, makes a bridge pass fail closed and write nothing; checked by asserting the pass errors and a post-run query of the real projects shows no change.
Every scenario's preview contained only targets in its intended project; checked by asserting an empty intersection against every other configured project for each preview.

Scratch projects deleted on teardown.'

criteria.criterion: The whole rehearsal runs green in the `jira-dc-harness` CI job against the ephemeral DC instance; checked by the job passing (not skipped — the fail-on-all-skip canary enforces at least one live scenario executed).

Every scratch project the run created is deleted on teardown and a read of each returns 404, including when a scenario fails mid-run; checked by injecting a post-creation failure into one scenario and asserting all scratch projects are gone (404) after teardown.
